answer: One way is to make every agent post a refundable deposit before it can trade, and tie its history to that deposit. A fake identity starts with no history, so it can only take small jobs until it earns trust. An attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must pay a thousand deposits and wait through the same slow build each time. That cost adds up, and a bad act burns the deposit. Think of each new inlet into the market as a gate that charges entry, the trust of a fresh identity sits at its nadir, and a single ember of bad behavior can wipe out the stake it took weeks to build.
